# What HCP Terraform API tokens the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Four kinds fall under one name, and it is HashiCorp that puts them there: the
# user token a person authenticates with, the team token a pipeline runs plans
# and applies under, the organization token that manages teams and workspaces
# and the token an agent pool authenticates with are one format, printed the
# same way by the four endpoints that issue them. Terraform Enterprise is the
# same application self-hosted and issues the same token.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef. An identifier
# is fourteen letters and digits, which is 0123456789abcd; a secret is
# sixty-seven, which is that run four times over with 012 behind it. No real
# token is either.

patterns: hcp-terraform-api-token

# The places a token is written, which are the places HashiCorp's own
# documentation puts one: the environment variable the CLI reads it from, the
# credentials block of a CLI configuration file, the credentials file terraform
# login writes, the bearer header an API request carries it in and the command
# line a curl example writes that header on.

case:     a token in an environment assignment
in:       TF_TOKEN_app_terraform_io=0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      TF_TOKEN_app_terraform_io=«hcp-terraform-api-token»

case:     a token in a cli credentials block
in:       credentials "app.terraform.io" {\n  token = "0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012"\n}
out:      credentials "app.terraform.io" {\n  token = "«hcp-terraform-api-token»"\n}

case:     a token in the credentials file terraform login writes
in:       {"credentials":{"app.terraform.io":{"token":"0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012"}}}
out:      {"credentials":{"app.terraform.io":{"token":"«hcp-terraform-api-token»"}}}

case:     a token in a bearer token header
in:       Authorization: Bearer 0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      Authorization: Bearer «hcp-terraform-api-token»

case:     a token on a command line
in:       curl -H "Authorization: Bearer 0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012" https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/account/details
out:      curl -H "Authorization: Bearer «hcp-terraform-api-token»" https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/account/details

# The alphabet, which is the letters of both cases with the digits. gitleaks and
# betterleaks admit the hyphen, the underscore and the equals sign in the
# secret, and what those three characters would let a match run over is the
# hyphenated slug and the snake-cased identifier a log line is full of.

case:     portions written in uppercase
in:       0123456789ABCD.atlasv1.0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF012
out:      «hcp-terraform-api-token»

case:     a hyphen in the secret
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef-123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef-123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012

case:     an underscore in the identifier
in:       0123456789abc_.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      0123456789abc_.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012

case:     an equals sign in the secret
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01=
out:      0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01=

# The counts either side of the separator, which are fourteen and sixty-seven.
# HashiCorp states no grammar; what it publishes is one token apiece on the four
# endpoints that issue them, and all four are those two counts. They are read
# exactly rather than as floors, and there is no boundary either side, so a
# longer run is a token with characters written against its ends and those
# characters stay in the text.

case:     an identifier one character short
in:       0123456789abc.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      0123456789abc.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012

case:     a secret one character short
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01
out:      0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01

case:     runs longer than the counts either side
in:       xy0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123
out:      xy«hcp-terraform-api-token»3

# The separator, which is the whole of what tells this format from text. It is
# read in the one case HashiCorp writes it, both full stops are asked for, and
# the version behind the name is not the API's, which is v2 in every path a
# token is spent on.

case:     an uppercase separator
in:       0123456789abcd.ATLASV1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      0123456789abcd.ATLASV1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012

case:     the separator without the full stop it opens with
in:       0123456789abcdatlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      0123456789abcdatlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012

case:     the separator without the full stop it closes with
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv10123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      0123456789abcd.atlasv10123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012

case:     a hyphen where the separator opens
in:       0123456789abcd-atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      0123456789abcd-atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012

case:     the version the token format does not carry
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv2.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      0123456789abcd.atlasv2.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012

# What a token may be written against. There is no boundary on either side, so a
# token keeps its span whatever word character abuts it — and what abuts it
# stays in the text, since both counts are read exactly.

case:     a token after an underscore
in:       TF_TOKEN_0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      TF_TOKEN_«hcp-terraform-api-token»

case:     a token after a letter
in:       x0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      x«hcp-terraform-api-token»

case:     a word written against a token
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012suffix
out:      «hcp-terraform-api-token»suffix

case:     a token at the end of a sentence
in:       the token is 0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012.
out:      the token is «hcp-terraform-api-token».

case:     a token between multi-byte text with nothing between them
in:       日本語0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012日本語
out:      日本語«hcp-terraform-api-token»日本語

case:     a token followed by crlf
in:       token=0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012\r\n
out:      token=«hcp-terraform-api-token»\r\n

case:     a token in a query string
in:       https://app.terraform.io/x?token=0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012&page=2
out:      https://app.terraform.io/x?token=«hcp-terraform-api-token»&page=2

case:     a token in parentheses
in:       (0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012)
out:      («hcp-terraform-api-token»)

case:     a token cut short with an ellipsis
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef...
out:      0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef...

# Two tokens written together. A separator carries two full stops and neither
# portion may hold one, so the tokens below are two values and are redacted
# apart whether or not anything is written between them.

case:     two tokens with nothing between them
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0120123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      «hcp-terraform-api-token»«hcp-terraform-api-token»

case:     two tokens separated by a space
in:       0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012 0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      «hcp-terraform-api-token» «hcp-terraform-api-token»

# What this pattern redacts that HCP Terraform did not issue. Vagrant Cloud
# writes its personal tokens in the same separator, the same two counts and the
# same alphabet, which is what trufflehog carrying a second detector on one
# expression records. Nothing in either string reads the two apart, so such a
# token is redacted under this name rather than left in the text — declining it
# would mean declining every HCP Terraform token there is.

case:     a vagrant cloud token
in:       VAGRANT_CLOUD_TOKEN=0123456789abcd.atlasv1.0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012
out:      VAGRANT_CLOUD_TOKEN=«hcp-terraform-api-token»

# A HashiCorp credential of another kind, which this pattern locates nothing
# in, and the text an HCP Terraform log line is written from, which
# carries the host name a token is spent against without carrying a separator.

case:     a vault token
in:       VAULT_TOKEN=hvs.0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      VAULT_TOKEN=hvs.0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a log line naming the api a token is spent on
in:       time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="applied run" url=https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/runs
out:      time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="applied run" url=https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/runs

case:     an environment variable holding a host name
in:       TF_CLOUD_HOSTNAME=app.terraform.io
out:      TF_CLOUD_HOSTNAME=app.terraform.io
